name: Alice
bio: A retired safecracker pulled back for one last job to pay off her brother's debts.
personality: Dry, guarded, fiercely loyal to family, hates being lied to.

name: Bob
bio: Alice's former partner, a nervous planner who owes money to the wrong people.
personality: Anxious, talkative, optimistic against all evidence.
speech_style: Rambles, over-explains, says 'trust me' a lot.

relationships.alice: Best friend; secretly feels guilty for dragging her in.

name: Carol
personality: Calm, observant, warm on the surface.
